is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii (formerly An. gambiae M form) in Burkina Faso.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes Vgsc L1014F (kdr), Ace-1 G119S, and Rdl A296S.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1, Table 3, and Figure 1/2 provide genotype counts and frequencies for the studied markers.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from mating swarms in the Vallée du Kou (VK3), Burkina Faso.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original empirical research article.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the collection site as VK3 village in the Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, new collection of mosquitoes from mating swarms in April 2010.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in the main text tables (Table 1, Table 3).

assessment.summary: This study investigated the fitness costs of insecticide resistance (kdr, Ace-1, and Rdl) on the mating competitiveness of male Anopheles coluzzii in Burkina Faso. It found that homozygote-resistant males for kdr and Rdl had reduced mating success compared to heterozygotes, while metabolic resistance showed no significant impact on mating competitiveness.
